name: public-board-moderation-gate
cost_provenance: measured 2026-09-30 on the dev workstation (win32, under concurrent cargo load), static mode; see docs/planning/project-checks-review-2026-09.md
question: Can a public board read or vote touch a non-approved row or leak PII? Every SQL string in every board read function carries the approved filter once per FROM/JOIN feedback and selects no PII column; handlers/board.rs calls only the three allowlisted board-safe repository reads and no raw sqlx.

output.schema: PASS or FAIL <n> with probe-level offender detail (file:line). Exit 0 PASS, 1 FAIL, 2 environment error. A missing target is a FAIL, never a vacuous PASS.

consultation.typical_sessions_using: every-commit touching the moderation state machine, the board read path, or the board wire shapes

consumer_scope: feedbackmonk: every change that touches the paths in freshness.triggers; gated at finalize (verification.projectOracles: gate) and in CI.
fallback: Read .claude/project-oracles/public-board-moderation-gate/README.md: it lists each probe as rewritten on 2026-09-30 and what to check by hand; the `question` above is the one-paragraph form.

provenance.authored_by: Stage 0 freeze (scaffold) — Probe B/C finalized + hardened + ACTIVATED against the board path at Stage 1. Probe A+B+C all green (GATE 1 oracle criterion met). v1.1.0 (PF-BOARD-VOTING-01): Probe B EXTENDED to the vote path (D3) — every board.rs handler writing through state.board_votes must run ensure_board_enabled + an approved-only resolution (resolve_approved_board_*) BEFORE the write; the resolution fn is itself a board-read fn so its approved-only SQL literal is pinned by the per-read-fn check. Gracefully skipped before voting is wired.
provenance.hardening_note: v1.0.0: Probe B is BOARD-READ-SCOPED — the board read fns are repository fns named *board* that query `FROM feedback` (excludes the PII-allowed admin queue `list_pending_for_admin` AND board-SETTINGS fns that query `projects`). Closes the stub's false-PASS hole (it searched all of feedback.rs and could be satisfied by an unrelated query's marker). The approved-only literal is required PER read fn (a regression dropping the filter from just one of the two reads is caught, not masked by the other). PII + feedback_replies scans cover the handler wire shape AND each repo read fn body (a PII column SELECTed in the repo query was previously missed). APPROVED_SQL marker is whitespace/quote/::cast/IN('approved')-tolerant but still LITERAL-only (a bound param can't be statically proven always-'approved' and is correctly rejected). Added: non-approved-literal guard (catches != 'rejected' / IN('approved','pending') leaks); handler-binding check (the handler must invoke the approved-only board reads, mirroring approval-gate-enforcement — catches a handler rewired to an unfiltered feedback read WITHOUT needing --full). Probe B/C activated at SP1: the `_iter_fn_bodies` extractor skips signature-only trait declarations (the real feedback.rs has list_public_board as both a trait decl and an impl — the naive text.find() grabbed the decl and mis-extracted; caught only by running against real code). Validated by an adversarial self-test (14/14: correct path + 4 spelling variants PASS; 9 bypass attempts FAIL, incl. trait-decl/impl and handler-bypass) kept in the worker workspace. Static-probe boundary (documented): C29 inv. 2 (board-disabled→404, approved-rows-from-non-opted-in-project) is outside this oracle's framed question (non-approved OR PII) and is covered by the behavioral Probe C (board_moderation_gate.rs::board_disabled_project_404s).
provenance.rationale: Testability Gate Flag 1 (Q2=5, highest plan-wide fidelity risk): the moderation gate is THE trust boundary between public submission and public exposure (FR-FBR-25a sibling). A happy-path test confirms `approve -> visible` but cannot prove the ABSENCE of a code path that returns an unapproved row on the public board, or that leaks submitter PII. This oracle is detection-from-CODE (state-machine source + SQL filter + wire shape + ledger), the anti-reward-hacking leg — it cannot be satisfied by a self-reported `is_public` flag. Scaffolded in Stage 0 (Probe A live; B/C co-evolve with Worker A); a green oracle with B+C active is GATE 1.
